title: The World is too Much With Us

topics.title: Materialism and the waste of human powers

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the poet criticises worldly preoccupation with getting and spending.
Interpret the oxymoron 'a sordid boon' and the loss it describes.

topics.title: Nature's beauty and humanity out of tune

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the personified images of the sea and the winds.
Explain what human beings are out of tune with and why it matters.

topics.title: The wish to be a Pagan

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the poet would rather be a Pagan suckled in a creed outworn.
Recognise the allusions to Proteus and Triton and their purpose.

topics.title: The poet and the sonnet form
topics.ncert_sections: About the Poet; Try This Out

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse the structure, rhyme scheme and turn of this Petrarchan sonnet.
Recall Wordsworth's life, views on poetic language and role in Romanticism.
